verdict.rationale: Gemini in Firebase provides AI-generated insights such as crash root-cause analysis, troubleshooting suggestions, and messaging campaign performance recommendations directly inside the product console, which matches the story well for those specific data domains. However, this is narrower than broad 'insights from my data' across all Firebase data (e.g., no evidence of AI insights over Firestore documents/queries generally, only Crashlytics and Messaging use cases are documented). missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of Gemini in Firebase quality, broader data-insight coverage beyond crashes/messaging (e.g., Firestore data analysis), and any community corroboration of these AI insight features.
